toolsPreview.name: lookup_security_contact
toolsPreview.description: Find security reporting channels for responsible vulnerability disclosure. Takes a domain, IP, URL, package name, repository, container image, mobile app, hardware device, browser extension, desktop app, or organization name. Returns bug bounty programs, security.txt contacts, VDP links, abuse contacts, and national/global CERT fallbacks ordered by applicability to the queried owner and asset. This is informational only — not legal advice.
